name: relay
note: A turn on the relay path (docs/proxy-behavior.md §9), written rather than captured: the claim this exercises is that the proxy forwards the bytes untouched, and the strongest evidence for that is a body no round trip through this proxy's own request types would reproduce. So the keys are out of order, the whitespace is its own, and the marker N8QP4W lives inside a field the proxy does not model at all — a re-encoding drops it, and drops it silently. The reply is the second provider's own frame shape; the code T5ZJ9C is spoken in a text delta, so it only arrives if the answering bytes reached the client as well.
